Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Colonel Ouvry Roberts, the Chief Staff Officer of the 10th Indian Infantry Division, arrived with the 1st KORR.

Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: By 18 April, the airlift of the 1st KORR to Shaibah was completed.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The troop-carrying aircraft used for this airlift were 7 _____ and 4 Atalantas supplemented by 4 DC-2s which had recently arrived in India
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The troop-carrying aircraft used for this airlift were 7 Valentias and 4 Atalantas supplemented by 4 DC-2s which had recently arrived in India.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: On 18 April, the 20th _____ landed at Basra, commanded by Brigadier Donald Powell
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: On 18 April, the 20th Indian Infantry Brigade landed at Basra, commanded by Brigadier Donald Powell. The 20th Indian Infantry Brigade included the 2nd battalion 8th Gurkha Rifles, 2nd battalion 7th Gurkha Rifles, and the 3rd battalion 11th Sikh Regiment.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The 20th _____ included the 2nd battalion 8th Gurkha Rifles, 2nd battalion 7th Gurkha Rifles, and the 3rd battalion 11th Sikh Regiment
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The forces being transported consisted of two senior staff officers from the 10th Indian Division headquarters, the 20th Indian Infantry Brigade, the personnel of the Royal Artillery's 3rd Field Regiment—without their guns—and certain ancillary troops.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages

Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The landing of the force transported by Convoy BP7 was covered by infantry of the 1st KORR which had arrived the previous day by air. By 19 April, the disembarkation of the force transported by Convoy BP7 at Basra was completed.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: By 19 April, the disembarkation of the force transported by _____7 at Basra was completed
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The landing of the force transported by Convoy BP7 was covered by infantry of the 1st KORR which had arrived the previous day by air. By 19 April, the disembarkation of the force transported by Convoy BP7 at Basra was completed.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages

Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Following the landing of the 20th Indian Infantry Brigade, Rashid Ali requested that the brigade be moved quickly through the country and that no more troops should arrive until the previous force had left.

Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Sir Kinahan Cornwallis, the _____ to Iraq, referred the issue to London and London replied that they had no interest in moving the troops out of the country and wanted to establish them within Iraq
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Sir Kinahan Cornwallis, the British Ambassador to Iraq, referred the issue to London and London replied that they had no interest in moving the troops out of the country and wanted to establish them within Iraq.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Sir Kinahan Cornwallis, the _____ located at the British Embassy in Baghdad and in contact with RAF Habbaniya via wireless, fully supported this action

Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Cornwallis was also instructed not to inform _____ who, as he had taken control of the country via a coup d'état, had no right to be informed about British troop movements

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages

Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Cornwallis was directed not to make agreements with an Iraqi government which had usurped its power. In addition, he was directed to avoid entangling himself with explanations to the Iraqis.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: In addition, he was directed to avoid entangling himself with explanations to the _____
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: In addition, he was directed to avoid entangling himself with explanations to the Iraqis.

Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Rashid Ali decided against opposing the landings at Basra.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: At 11:30 hours, the Iraqi envoy again made contact with Smart and accused the _____ of violating the Anglo-Iraqi treaty
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Sir Kinahan Cornwallis, the British Ambassador located at the British Embassy in Baghdad and in contact with RAF Habbaniya via wireless, fully supported this action. Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Smart replied that this was a political matter and he would have to refer the accusation to _____

Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Meanwhile, Iraqi forces had now occupied vital bridges over the Tigris and Euphrates rivers and reinforced their garrison at Ramadi, cutting off land links to RAF Habbaniya.

Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Initially, the Iraqi siege of _____ and the ability of the besieged British force there to withstand the siege was the primary focus of the conflict
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Starting early on 2 May, British airstrikes were launched against the Iraqis from RAF Habbaniya. Initially, the Iraqi siege of RAF Habbaniya and the ability of the besieged British force there to withstand the siege was the primary focus of the conflict.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: While the relief force from _____ arrived in Habbaniya after the siege was over, it did allow an immediate change over to the offensive
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: While the relief force from Palestine arrived in Habbaniya after the siege was over, it did allow an immediate change over to the offensive.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: At 05:00 on 2 May 33 aircraft from _____, out of the 56 operational aircraft based there, and eight Wellington bombers from Shaibah began their attack

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: A few of the Greek pilots being trained at _____ also joined in the RAF attack
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: While the relief force from Palestine arrived in Habbaniya after the siege was over, it did allow an immediate change over to the offensive. Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Within minutes the _____ on the escarpment replied by shelling the base, damaging some planes on the ground
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Within minutes the Iraqis on the escarpment replied by shelling the base, damaging some planes on the ground.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The Royal Iraqi Air Force (RIAF) also joined in the fray over _____

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: By the end of the day, the Iraqi force outside _____ had grown to roughly a brigade
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Throughout the day, the pilots from Habbaniya flew 193 sorties and claimed direct hits on Iraqi transports, armoured cars and artillery pieces; however five aircraft had been destroyed and several others put out of service. By the end of the day, the Iraqi force outside Habbaniya had grown to roughly a brigade.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: While the _____ on the escarpment carried live ammunition, many Iraqi soldiers were under the impression that they were on a training exercise
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: While the Iraqis on the escarpment carried live ammunition, many Iraqi soldiers were under the impression that they were on a training exercise.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Rashid Ali and the members of the _____ were shocked by the British defenders at RAF Habbaniya being prepared to fight rather than surrender
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Rashid Ali and the members of the Golden Square were shocked by the British defenders at RAF Habbaniya being prepared to fight rather than surrender.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: To compound the surprise and shock, many members of the _____ army were preparing for morning prayers when the attack was launched
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: To compound the surprise and shock, many members of the Muslim Iraqi army were preparing for morning prayers when the attack was launched.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: When the news reached the _____ in Baghdad, he immediately declared a jihad against the United Kingdom
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: When the news reached the Grand Mufti in Baghdad, he immediately declared a jihad against the United Kingdom.

Anglo-Iraqi War.question: In addition, the flow of _____ oil through the pipeline to Haifa was severed

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: On 3 May, the _____ bombing of the Iraqis continued; troop and gun positions on the plateau were targeted as well as the supply line to Baghdad
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: On 3 May, the British bombing of the Iraqis continued; troop and gun positions on the plateau were targeted as well as the supply line to Baghdad.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The Iraqi air base at _____ was also attacked and an Iraqi Savoia SM 79 bomber heading for Habbaniya was intercepted and shot down
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The Iraqi air base at Rashid was also attacked and an Iraqi Savoia SM 79 bomber heading for Habbaniya was intercepted and shot down. A bombing raid conducted by eight Wellington bombers on Rashid was briefly engaged by Iraqi fighters, but no losses were suffered.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The following day further air attacks were carried out on _____ troop positions and the Iraqi air force
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: On 3 May, the British bombing of the Iraqis continued; troop and gun positions on the plateau were targeted as well as the supply line to Baghdad. The Iraqi air base at Rashid was also attacked and an Iraqi Savoia SM 79 bomber heading for Habbaniya was intercepted and shot down.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: A bombing raid conducted by eight _____ bombers on Rashid was briefly engaged by Iraqi fighters, but no losses were suffered
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: A bombing raid conducted by eight Wellington bombers on Rashid was briefly engaged by Iraqi fighters, but no losses were suffered.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Bristol Blenheims escorted by _____ also conducted strafing attacks against airfields at Baghdad, Rashid and Mosul
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Bristol Blenheims escorted by Hurricanes also conducted strafing attacks against airfields at Baghdad, Rashid and Mosul.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: On 5 May, due to a car accident, _____-Marshal Smart was evacuated to Basra and then to India
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: On 5 May, due to a car accident, Air Vice-Marshal Smart was evacuated to Basra and then to India. Air Vice-Marshal John D'Albiac, from Greece, was to take command over aerial forces at Habbaniya and of all RAF forces in Iraq.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Colonel Roberts assumed de facto command of the land operations at _____ after the departure of Smart
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Colonel Roberts assumed de facto command of the land operations at RAF Habbaniya after the departure of Smart.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The attack was supported by the Assyrian levies, some RAF armoured cars, and two First World War-era _____-inch howitzers which had previously been decorating the entrance of the base's officers' mess
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The attack was supported by the Assyrian levies, some RAF armoured cars, and two First World War-era 4.5-inch howitzers which had previously been decorating the entrance of the base's officers' mess.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The guns were put in working order by some _____ gunners
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The guns were put in working order by some British gunners. The Iraqi force had abandoned substantial quantities of arms and equipment; the British garrison gained six Czechoslovak-built 3.7 inch howitzers along with 2,400 shells, one 18-pounder gun, one Italian tank, ten Crossley armoured cars, 79 trucks, three 20 mm anti-aircraft guns with 2,500 shells, 45 Bren light machine-guns, eleven Vickers machine guns, and 340 rifles with 500,000 rounds of ammunition.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: By dawn on _____ 7 May, RAF armoured cars reconnoitred the top of the escarpment and reported it to be deserted
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: By dawn on Wednesday 7 May, RAF armoured cars reconnoitred the top of the escarpment and reported it to be deserted.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The investment of _____, by Iraqi forces, had come to an end
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The investment of Habbaniya, by Iraqi forces, had come to an end.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The garrison had inflicted between 500 and _____ casualties on the besieging force, and taken many prisoners
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The garrison had inflicted between 500 and 1000 casualties on the besieging force, and taken many prisoners.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: On 6 May alone, 408 _____ troops were captured
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The investment of Habbaniya, by Iraqi forces, had come to an end. On 6 May alone, 408 Iraqi troops were captured.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The _____ objective was to safeguard British interests from Axis intervention in Iraq, to defeat the rebels, and to discredit Rashid's government
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The British objective was to safeguard British interests from Axis intervention in Iraq, to defeat the rebels, and to discredit Rashid's government.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: RAF armoured cars, reconnoitring ahead, soon found that the village of Sin el _____, on the Fallujah road, was occupied by Iraqi troops
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: RAF armoured cars, reconnoitring ahead, soon found that the village of Sin el Dhibban, on the Fallujah road, was occupied by Iraqi troops.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The 1st KORR and the _____ levies, supported by the RAF armoured cars, assaulted the position, driving the Iraqis out and taking over 300 prisoners
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The 1st KORR and the Assyrian levies, supported by the RAF armoured cars, assaulted the position, driving the Iraqis out and taking over 300 prisoners.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The Iraqi force retreating from _____ met with an Iraqi column moving towards Habbaniya from Fallujah in the afternoon
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The Iraqi force retreating from Habbaniya met with an Iraqi column moving towards Habbaniya from Fallujah in the afternoon. The two Iraqi forces met around 5 miles (8.0 km) east of Habbaniya on the Fallujah road.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Later in the afternoon _____ aircraft carried out three raids on the airbase and inflicted some damage
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The Iraqi force retreating from Habbaniya met with an Iraqi column moving towards Habbaniya from Fallujah in the afternoon. The two Iraqi forces met around 5 miles (8.0 km) east of Habbaniya on the Fallujah road.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The two Iraqi forces met around _____ (8.0 km) east of Habbaniya on the Fallujah road
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The two Iraqi forces met around 5 miles (8.0 km) east of Habbaniya on the Fallujah road.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Keep it up! Over the course of the next few days the RAF, from _____ and Shaibah, effectively eliminated the Iraqi air force
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Keep it up! Over the course of the next few days the RAF, from Habbaniya and Shaibah, effectively eliminated the Iraqi air force.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: However, from 11 May, _____ (Luftwaffe) aircraft took the place of the Iraqi aircraft
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: However, from 11 May, German Air Force (Luftwaffe) aircraft took the place of the Iraqi aircraft.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: There had also been discussions on war material being sent to support the Iraqis and other Arab factions in fighting the _____
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: There had also been discussions on war material being sent to support the Iraqis and other Arab factions in fighting the British. The British quickly learned of the German arrangements through intercepted Italian diplomatic transmissions.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: On 3 May, _____ von Ribbentrop persuaded German dictator Adolf Hitler to secretly return Dr

Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Fritz Grobba to Iraq to head up a diplomatic mission to channel support to the _____ regime

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The British quickly learned of the German arrangements through intercepted _____ diplomatic transmissions
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: The British quickly learned of the German arrangements through intercepted Italian diplomatic transmissions.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Vichy France, which controlled the neighbouring _____, became keen to facilitate any agreement between Iraq, Italy and Germany
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Vichy France, which controlled the neighbouring Mandatory Syrian Republic, became keen to facilitate any agreement between Iraq, Italy and Germany.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: It was therefore proposed that Axis access to Iraq would be facilitated via _____-held Syria

It was therefore proposed that Axis access to Iraq would be facilitated via French-held Syria.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: The French also agreed to allow passage of other weapons and material as well as loaning several airbases in northern Syria, to _____, for the transport of German aircraft to Iraq

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages

Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Darlan had actually ensured that the _____ included a proposal that the French would launch an offensive against the British-held Iraqi oilfields, and the oil would be made available to the Germans
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: On 6 May, in accordance with the Paris Protocols, Germany concluded a deal with the Vichy French government to release war materials, including aircraft, from sealed stockpiles in Syria and transport them to the Iraqis. Darlan had actually ensured that the Protocols included a proposal that the French would launch an offensive against the British-held Iraqi oilfields, and the oil would be made available to the Germans.

Anglo-Iraqi War.subject: Indian Languages
Anglo-Iraqi War.question: Between 10 and 15 May the aircraft arrived in Mosul via _____ airbases in Syria, and then commenced regular aerial attacks on British forces
Anglo-Iraqi War.fact: Between 10 and 15 May the aircraft arrived in Mosul via Vichy French airbases in Syria, and then commenced regular aerial attacks on British forces.
